differences_from_upstream: Native AVBD with nominal BAM and foot-ground contact only; no self-collision or physical domain randomization
Five equally sampled commands: four target directions and standing; neutral head/body commands
Horizontal velocity reward variance narrowed from 0.1 to 0.0025; vertical variance kept at 0.1 to preserve normal stepping motion
Small explicit initial pose perturbations; fixed 20 ms actuator and joint-velocity observation delay, no sensor noise
Actor weights and normalization transferred, new critic and optimizer; lower learning rate, entropy coefficient, and initial action standard deviation 0.15 rad
Native contact timing/force and finite-iteration dynamics are not full upstream parity
